props.gloss_en: Beit Shammai: [oil and myrtle before him] one blesses over the oil and afterwards over the myrtle
Beit Hillel: one blesses over the myrtle and afterwards over the oil
Rabban Gamliel: I will decide -- oil: we have the benefit of its scent and of anointing with it; myrtle: of its scent, not of anointing
R' Yochanan: the halakha is as the words of the decisor
Rav Pappa [brought oil and myrtle] took and blessed over the myrtle first, and then over the oil
thus said Rava: the halakha is as Beit Hillel
Beit Shammai: [oil and wine before them] he holds the oil in his right hand and the wine in his left, blesses over the oil and then over the wine
Beit Hillel: he holds the wine in his right hand and the oil in his left, blesses over the wine and then over the oil
and he wipes it [the oil] on the head of the servant
and if the servant is a Torah scholar, he wipes it on the wall
because it is unbecoming for a Torah scholar to go out to the market perfumed
six things are unbecoming a Torah scholar: he should not go out to the market perfumed
and he should not go out alone at night
and he should not go out in patched shoes
and he should not converse with a woman in the market
and he should not recline in a company of amei haaretz
and he should not enter the beit midrash last
and some say: also, he should not take long strides
and [some say] he should not walk with an upright posture
R' Yochanan: [he should not go out perfumed] in a place where they are suspected of mishkav zachar
Rav Sheshet: we said this only of [perfume on] his garment
but on his body -- sweat removes it
Rav Pappa: and his hair is like his garment
and some say [Rav Pappa said]: it is like his body
[he should not go out alone at night] because of suspicion
and we said this only where he has no fixed time
but if he has a fixed time, it is known that he is going to his fixed time
R' Chiyya bar Abba: it is unbecoming for a Torah scholar to go out in patched shoes
but R' Chiyya bar Abba went out [in patched shoes]
Mar Zutra b. Rav Nachman: [it is unbecoming] with a patch upon a patch
and we said this only of the upper [of the shoe]; of the sole, we have no concern
and of the upper we said this only on the road; at home, we have no concern
and we said this only in the summer; in the rainy season, we have no concern
Rav Chisda: [he should not converse with a woman in the market] even if she is his wife
the baraita: even if she is his wife, even his daughter, even his sister
because not everyone knows who his female relatives are
what is the reason [he should not recline with amei haaretz]? lest he be drawn after them
[he should not enter last] because they call him negligent (poshea)
as the master said: a long stride takes one five-hundredth of a man's eyesight
what is his remedy? let him restore it with the kiddush [cup] of Shabbat eve
as the master said: one who walks with an upright posture even four cubits -- it is as if he pushes the feet of the Shekhina
as it is written: 'the whole earth is full of His glory' (Isa 6:3)
